items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I still remember the smell of the vinyl and the yellow Dial label with Bird and Diz and Miles and the Billy Eckstine Big Band.

ctx.x: So for you, that meant that you were listening by osmosis...absorbing by osmosis, I guess, quite a bit of this music from very early on.

That was it. My dad had a stack of 78-rpm vinyl, and that’s what he played all the time. That’s what I grew up listening to. I still remember the smell of the vinyl and the yellow Dial label with Bird and Diz and Miles and the Billy Eckstine Big Band.
I also gather from a prior interview that you first had piano lessons when you were 9, with a fellow named Salvatore Sullo.
